patterns.purpose: Shows a set of items as cards that wrap to fit the screen.
fitsWhen: A small set of items, each worth a summary
patterns.responsive: One card per row on phones. More per row as width allows, through a Gallery.

patterns.purpose: Runs a method with no inputs after the person confirms it (archetype Confirm).
patterns.responsive: A small modal on wide screens; on phones, the full width less the standard margin.

patterns.purpose: Collects a method's inputs in a short form, previews the change, then runs it (archetype Fill in).
fitsWhen: The method's archetype is Fill in
patterns.responsive: A medium modal on wide screens; on phones, the full width less the standard margin.

patterns.purpose: Shows the object and another of the same type side by side, differences marked, then previews and runs the method (archetype Compare and decide).
fitsWhen: The method's archetype is Compare and decide
patterns.responsive: The two cards sit side by side from md up and stack on phones.

patterns.purpose: Reviews a method's change, then signs it with the signature's meaning (archetype Review and sign).
fitsWhen: The method's archetype is Review and sign
patterns.responsive: A medium modal on wide screens; on phones, the full width less the standard margin, with the steps behind a toggle.

patterns.purpose: Starts a method that runs in the background, then follows its progress until it ends (archetype Start and track).
fitsWhen: The method's archetype is Start and track
patterns.responsive: A small modal on wide screens; on phones, the full width less the standard margin. The progress bar takes the modal's width.

patterns.purpose: Shows text a connected model drafted, marked as generated, for a person to accept, edit or discard (archetype Review a draft).
fitsWhen: The method's archetype is Review a draft
patterns.responsive: Takes the place of the view at every width. The draft's text wraps; on phones the actions wrap onto as many rows as they need.

patterns.purpose: One object in the object panel: its identity, state and methods, then tabs for its overview and each relationship end that holds many objects (design system 4.4).
fitsWhen: A person opens an object from a card, a link or a search result
patterns.responsive: Three quarters of the content area from lg up and all of it below, or all of it when expanded. Tabs scroll sideways on phones; cards in a tab stack.
